description: This file defines enums, classes, and functions related to ROHC (Robust Header Compression) configuration, including profile selection, profile bitmap management, and configuration parameters, with associated formatters for output.

classes.name: ocudu::rohc::rohc_profile_config
classes.description: Manages the bitmap of enabled ROHC profiles, allowing enabling/disabling profiles and checking their status.

methods.name: to_string
methods.description: Converts ROHC profile type or enum to its string representation.

methods.name: to_number
methods.description: Converts a ROHC profile enum to its numeric value.
